assertions.title: Token refresh during quota check

steps.action: Search for VAL-CROSS-005 tagged test in test file
steps.expected: Dedicated integration test exists
steps.observed: No test explicitly tagged VAL-CROSS-005 exists in shuvquota.test.js

steps.action: Inspect handleFactoryQuota implementation in lib/handlers.js line 2483
steps.expected: handleFactoryQuota calls ensureFreshFactoryToken before fetchFactoryUsage
steps.observed: Confirmed: line 2483 calls 'await ensureFreshFactoryToken(account, allAccounts)' in a loop before 'const usage = await fetchFactoryUsage(account, { billingDay })' for each account

steps.action: Verify ensureFreshFactoryToken unit tests cover the mechanism
steps.expected: Token refresh mechanism fully tested: expired→refresh→persist, failure→unchanged
steps.observed: 9 tests all pass: expired token triggers refresh, successful refresh persists to container+auth.v2, refresh failure leaves data unchanged (no corruption), refresh failure with API key returns true (fallback for quota fetch), buffer window proactive refresh works

steps.action: Verify quota flow uses refreshed token after refresh
steps.expected: After ensureFreshFactoryToken mutates account.accessToken, fetchFactoryUsage uses the new token
steps.observed: ensureFreshFactoryToken modifies account object in-place (account.accessToken = newJwt, confirmed by tests). The same account object is then passed to fetchFactoryUsage, which reads account.accessToken for the Authorization header. This is confirmed by the VAL-CROSS-002 tests that capture the Authorization header.

steps.action: Verify refresh failure produces actionable error
steps.expected: When refresh fails and no API key fallback, user sees re-auth message
steps.observed: ensureFreshFactoryToken returns false when refresh fails and no API key. The caller (handleFactoryQuota) proceeds with the expired token, which will result in an API error that is caught and displayed per-account (confirmed by VAL-QUOTA-012 pattern in handlers.js).

evidence.sourceInspection: lib/handlers.js:2483 confirms ensureFreshFactoryToken called before fetchFactoryUsage in handleFactoryQuota loop
evidence.note: No dedicated VAL-CROSS-005 tagged test exists, but the behavior is verified through: (1) ensureFreshFactoryToken unit tests proving refresh mechanism works, (2) source code confirming handleFactoryQuota calls ensureFreshFactoryToken before each fetch, (3) VAL-CROSS-002 tests confirming the quota flow uses the correct token from the account object
